answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 32003 Country: India Title: Once after qurankhani,people gotup and combindly started singing salam"Mustafa shane rehmat pe lakhon salam. Question: Once after qurankhani,people gotup and combindly started singing salam"Mustafa shane rehmat pe lakhon salam...".It was said while performing this if one is not standing up then it is an insult to nabie karim swallal lahu alaihi sallam.please give the detail of the above act according to the sariah. Answer ID: 32003 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 757/669/B=1432) The prevalent Quran Khawani and the reading of durood collectively are merely ignorance and show. It is good and righteous act to send durood and salam to the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) but this should be done in privacy and thinking about the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) with full attention. Not only two or four times, rather one should read duroods that are proved from the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) 2-4 thousand times. It is merely ignorant and artifice to read out durood collectively after Quran Khawani in singing tune just to make others hear and to show. This is neither proved from the holy Quran and hadith, nor from the Companions of the holy Prophet and their successors and pious elders. من أحدث فى أمرنا هذا ماليس منه فهو رد (بخارى و مسلم) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
